name: manual_f12bef
claim: Code that can fall back to a live subnet sweep must reuse the outcome for a short window while still reading faster sources first, because per-model host resolution multiplies the sweep. Tests that are not about discovery must disable live probes.

decisions.notes: One route_task call asked for the Windows host 60 times at about 20 seconds per sweep, which stalled the policy-stack tests whenever no override, fresh snapshot or environment endpoint existed. Counted with discovery replaced by a counter.
